protocol_checks.vulnerability_mechanism: Confirmed. In 7.0.4, authenticate() runs DefaultPreAuthenticationChecks before additionalAuthenticationChecks; locked, disabled, or account-expired users throw before the real PasswordEncoder.matches call, while an unknown username executes DaoAuthenticationProvider.mitigateAgainstTimingAttack and pays for a dummy match. The resulting timing difference exposes those user attributes/account existence.
protocol_checks.atomic_bic: Confirmed as c076f0f2e190c73a17379d05935c2c81657adee9. A path-limited reverse -S search identifies this as the first commit adding USER_NOT_FOUND_PASSWORD and password validation in the UsernameNotFoundException path. The earlier pre-check ordering alone did not distinguish unknown users from status-rejected users because both skipped password work.
protocol_checks.immediate_parent_absence: Confirmed at f3b143f677b80cddbdaac58c56a90d7bb1e4ac22. Its DaoAuthenticationProvider catch block immediately rethrows UsernameNotFoundException and contains no dummy password validation, while its AbstractUserDetailsAuthenticationProvider already has preAuthenticationChecks before additionalAuthenticationChecks; the complete timing oracle is therefore absent.
